metadata.name: vox-deps
metadata.description: System-level audio dependencies for Vox TTS/STT plugin

default.description: No additional system packages needed on Windows
installScript: echo Vox: No additional system packages needed on Windows

aiPrompts.versionDiscovery: Check distribution package repositories for current versions of system audio libraries: libasound2-dev (Debian/Ubuntu), alsa-lib-devel (Fedora/RHEL), alsa-lib (Arch); libsndfile1/libsndfile; ffmpeg. Versions are managed by the OS package manager — verify availability via `apt-cache show <pkg>`, `dnf info <pkg>`, or `pacman -Si <pkg>`. No upstream version pinning needed.
aiPrompts.urlResolution: Install via native package managers — no direct URLs. Debian/Ubuntu/Mint: apt. Fedora/RHEL/CentOS: dnf. Arch/Manjaro: pacman. On Windows no system packages are required (Piper ONNX runtime is bundled with the Vox plugin).
aiPrompts.updateGuidance: These are stable ALSA/ffmpeg system libraries — rarely need updates outside normal OS patching. Only revisit if Vox plugin upstream changes audio backend or adds new audio format support. When adding a new Linux distribution, follow the existing variants pattern (variant name = package-manager name, set requiresSudo: true, list distribution-specific package names).
